MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
WITH i,pr,apoc.coll.toSet(ks) AS s WHERE size(s)>=2
RETURN count(i) AS n, count(DISTINCT pr) AS pc

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS l
UNWIND l AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS s WHERE size(s)>=2
RETURN collect(i.issueKey) AS issues, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS projs, size(apoc.coll.flatten(collect(s))) AS x

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS l
UNWIND l AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS s WHERE size(s)>=2
UNWIND s AS person
WITH i,pr,person
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, pr.projectKey AS project, person, t.historyId AS te

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS l
UNWIND l AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS s WHERE size(s)>=2
WITH collect({i:i.issueKey,p:pr.projectKey,s:s}) AS rows
UNWIND (reduce(acc=[],r IN rows|acc+[x IN r.s|{id:x,kind:'person'}]) + [r IN rows|{id:r.p,kind:'project'}]) AS e
RETURN DISTINCT e.id AS id, e.kind AS kind

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b, collect(t.historyId) AS tes
WHERE size([x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL | x])>=0
WITH i,tes, apoc.coll.toSet(a+b) AS s
RETURN 1

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS l
UNWIND l AS k
WITH i,count(DISTINCT k) AS n WHERE n>=2
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b, collect(t.historyId) AS tes
WITH i,tes,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS l
UNWIND l AS k
WITH i,tes,count(DISTINCT k) AS n WHERE n>=2
UNWIND tes AS te
RETURN DISTINCT te
